title: Multisensory processing and temporal binding in paranoid schizophrenia
summary: This study is conducted with people who are mentally healthy as well as with people who have schizophrenia. The aim of the study is to understand how the condition affects the perception of one’s own actions and their consequences. During the study, you will be asked to complete tasks in which you estimate short time intervals between two events. In addition, you will be asked to complete two questionnaires.

interventions.name: In four experimental blocks of up to 20 minutes each, participants (both patients and healthy control participants) estimated the temporal interval between two events. In two of these blocks, participants performed a button press that was followed, after a short delay of several hundred milliseconds
